name: explainer-video
description: Explainer video Skill for AI agents: make long videos that hold up past the first minute. Eight steps, from preflight to retrospective.

interface.shortDescription: Long explainer videos that hold up past the first minute
interface.longDescription: Eight steps for making a long explainer video with an agent: check the tools, interview for the format and the feel, lock the narration and one look, delegate each segment to a fresh sub-agent with a framework rather than constraints, watch the first cut like a viewer, polish it in a new session, and fine-tune the Skill with what the film taught. Remotion and FFmpeg, running locally.
defaultPrompt: Use the explainer-video skill to make a video from my script.
